title: Ionization- and iron-tuned recognition of icaritin by albumin and transferrin: from spectrofluorimetry to multiscale modeling.
authors: Milisavljevic, Kristina; Mrkalic, Emina; Kaluderovic, Goran N; Milanovic, Ziko
one_liner_zh: 该文研究黄酮类化合物icaritin与血清白蛋白和转铁蛋白的相互作用，虽采用分子对接和MD模拟，但对象为小分子-蛋白而非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题TF-DNA结合机制无关。
abstract: Serum transport proteins critically influence the pharmacokinetics and systemic bioavailability of polyphenolic compounds; however, the molecular determinants governing their recognition of ionizable flavonoids remain insufficiently understood. Herein, the interaction of icaritin (ICT), a prenylated flavonoid with promising pharmacological activity, with bovine serum albumin (BSA) and transferrin (Tf) was investigated using an integrated spectrofluorimetric and multiscale computational approach. Fluorescence quenching experiments confirmed stable complex formation with both proteins. ICT exhibited strong affinity toward BSA (Ka = 5.76 x 10(5)-1.12 x 10(7) M(-1)) and Tf (K(a) = 5.07 x 10(7)-2.49 x 10(8) M(-1)), with distinct recognition mechanisms. Site-marker experiments revealed warfarin-dependent changes in the apparent BSA-ICT binding parameters without conclusively identifying a preferred binding site, while Tf binding was strongly influenced by both ligand ionization and iron-loading state. Molecular docking, molecular dynamics simulations and MM/GBSA-MM/PBSA calculations demonstrated that neutral and monoanionic ICT species predominate under physiological conditions, with the monoanionic form displaying enhanced protein affinity. Additional ONIOM (Our Own N-layered Integrated Molecular Orbital and Molecular Mechanics) QM/MM calculations supported the electronic stabilization of the protein-ligand complexes. The obtained results demonstrate that ICT recognition by BSA and Tf in the investigated model systems depends on ligand ionization, protein architecture and the iron-loading state of transferrin, providing a molecular basis for understanding ICT-protein interactions and their potential relevance to serum protein binding.
abstract_zh: 血清转运蛋白显著影响多酚类化合物的药代动力学和全身生物利用度；然而，调控其识别可电离类黄酮的分子决定因素仍未被充分理解。在此，采用综合荧光光谱法和多尺度计算方法，研究了具有前景药理活性的异戊烯基类黄酮淫羊藿次苷（icaritin, ICT）与牛血清白蛋白（bovine serum albumin, BSA）和转铁蛋白（transferrin, Tf）的相互作用。荧光猝灭实验确认了与两种蛋白形成稳定复合物。ICT对BSA（Ka = 5.76 x 10(5)-1.12 x 10(7) M(-1)）和Tf（K(a) = 5.07 x 10(7)-2.49 x 10(8) M(-1)）表现出强亲和力，且识别机制不同。位点标记实验揭示了华法林依赖性变化影响表观BSA-ICT结合参数，但未明确识别出优先结合位点，而Tf结合受配体电离状态和铁负载状态强烈影响。分子对接、分子动力学模拟和MM/GBSA-MM/PBSA计算表明，在生理条件下，中性和单阴离子ICT物种占主导，其中单阴离子形式表现出增强的蛋白亲和力。额外的ONIOM（Our Own N-layered Integrated Molecular Orbital and Molecular Mechanics）QM/MM计算支持了蛋白-配体复合物的电子稳定化。所得结果表明，在所研究的模型系统中，ICT被BSA和Tf识别取决于配体电离状态、蛋白结构以及转铁蛋白的铁负载状态，为理解ICT-蛋白相互作用及其与血清蛋白结合的潜在相关性提供了分子基础。
